newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Volume up, index down at Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Volume up, index down at Estonian bourse.

text.p: Volume grew slightly while the index fell at Estonia's bourse on Thursday, dealers said.
Overall market volume was 10.9 million kroons compared with 8.3 million kroons on Wednesday and the index fell by 0.27 percent to 105.84.
Market leader Hansa Bank accounted for the lion's share of volume at 9.2 million kroons and closed at 107.25 kroons against 107 kroons.
Local media reports have suggested that Hansa Bank plans to sell its 21 percent stake in Savings Bank but Hansa Bank said in a statement today that no decisions have been made yet.
